annotation.bound_parties_text: The rules bind units and individuals in Beijing (no flying, holding, storing, transporting, selling or renting drones), e-commerce operators, entities granted special guarantees, and municipal/district governments and departments responsible for drone management.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: 禁止向在本市行政区域内的单位和个人销售、出租无人驾驶航空器及其核心部件。电子商务经营者应当采取有效措施落实前款规定。
annotation.dates_quote: 本规定自2026年11月15日起施行。
annotation.robot_provision_quote: 为了加强本市无人驾驶航空器的管理，维护首都安全
